# testdata

Reference OOXML files used by the roundtrip harness (`scripts/roundtrip.sh`) and the format crates.

**Provisional files are NOT authoritative for "opens in MS Office" claims.** They are produced by
LibreOffice and only prove that LibreOffice can read them. Replace them with real Office-authored
files as soon as those are available. Regenerate with `scripts/gen-testdata.sh` (sources in
`scripts/testdata-src/`), check with `scripts/gen-testdata.sh --verify`.

|------|--------|----------|

(the comments workbook by `scripts/testdata-src/xlsx/comments.py`, the pivot workbooks by `scripts/testdata-src/xlsx/pivot.py` and `pivot_c3.py`, the protection workbook by `scripts/testdata-src/xlsx/protection.py`, the P9-C5 workbook by `condfmt_c5.py`, the P9-C7 workbook by `cells_c7.py`)
(openpyxl, see `docs/setup.md`); openpyxl writes no reference caches, so they also test that the
writer computes them.

### docx reference suite (`docx/provisional-NN-*.docx`) - PROVISIONAL

50 small documents (one feature topic each, combinations in 47-50) generated by LibreOffice 25.2 headless; **replace with Word-authored files**. `docx/manifest.json` lists per file the topic, a feature list and the paragraph count; vocabulary and workflow in `docs/docx-suite.md`. Regenerate with `scripts/gen-docx-suite.sh` (sources in `scripts/testdata-src/docx/`), check with `--verify`.

P9-W3 added two files the same way (converted alone, manifest entries appended): `docx/provisional-63-style-sets-properties.docx` – linked styles with style-set looks (Shaded Heading: caps, white on blue shading; Lined Heading: bottom rule, small caps, expanded spacing), a run in the linked character style, a words-only underline (`w:u words`), TITLE / SUBJECT / AUTHOR / KEYWORDS fields and a DOCPROPERTY Company field, core properties and Company in `app.xml` (`gen.py patch` adds what LibreOffice cannot export: the words underline, the DOCPROPERTY field and the company); `docx/provisional-64-template-memo.dotx` – a Word template converted with LibreOffice's "MS Word 2007 XML Template" filter (main part `wordprocessingml.template.main+xml`): Memo title, To / From / Re / Date lines with a tab and a DATE field, a body placeholder.

P9-W4 added one file the same way (converted alone, manifest entry appended): `docx/provisional-65-drawings-floating-2.docx` – a group of a rectangle and an oval (`wpg:wgp`), two linked text boxes (`wps:txbx id` / `wps:linkedTxbx id seq`), a drawing canvas with two shapes (`wpc:wpc`), a centred picture with square wrapping on both sides, a picture with a hyperlink and ScreenTip (`a:hlinkClick`), soft edges and a bevel (`a:softEdge`, `a:sp3d/a:bevelT`), a HYPERLINK field with `\o`, a hidden decorative oval (`wp:docPr hidden`, `adec:decorative`); `gen.py patch` adds what LibreOffice cannot export: the chain, the canvas, the ScreenTip, the bevel, the field and the hidden/decorative marks.

P9-W5 added one file the same way (converted alone, manifest entry appended): `docx/provisional-66-tables-2-columns-symbols.docx` – a header merged over three columns above a column merged over two rows (`w:gridSpan`, `w:vMerge`), a fixed-layout table (`w:tblLayout`) that floats right of the column with the text around it (`w:tblpPr`, `w:tblOverlap never`), a table style with a bold, shaded header row (`w:tblStylePr firstRow`) and its look (`w:tblLook`), first-line and hanging indents, left / center / decimal / right / bar tab stops, a section with two unequal columns and a line between (`w:cols w:equalWidth="0"` with `w:col` widths, `w:sep`), and the special characters non-breaking hyphen / optional hyphen (`w:noBreakHyphen`, `w:softHyphen`), non-breaking space, en and em dash, © ® ™, ellipsis and smart quotes; `gen.py patch` adds what LibreOffice cannot export: the floating position, the table style and look, and the bar tab.

P9-W6 added one file the same way (converted alone, manifest entry appended): `docx/provisional-67-comments-notes-fields-2.docx` – a comment whose text has a bold word and an @mention (a `w:hyperlink` to `mailto:` in the `Mention` style, with `word/_rels/comments.xml.rels`), `word/people.xml` with a local and a directory account (`w15:presenceInfo`), a reply and a resolved thread (`commentsExtended`), a comment range inside a footnote (without `w:commentReference`, which LibreOffice 25.2 cannot load there), a footnote continuation separator with own text, a header with `STYLEREF "Heading 1"`, `PAGE` and `SECTIONPAGES`, `SEQ` with `\s 1` and `\c`, a locked `DATE` (`w:fldLock`), a bookmark and a `REF \p \h`; `gen.py patch` adds what LibreOffice cannot export (all of the above except the reply, the resolved thread and `PAGE`) and, new, whole parts (`ADD_PARTS`).

### pptx reference suite (`pptx/provisional-NN-*.pptx`) - PROVISIONAL

35 small decks (one feature topic each, combinations in 22 and 25) generated by LibreOffice 25.2 headless; **replace with PowerPoint-authored files**. Deck 34 (`provisional-34-views-design.pptx`, P9-S3) adds what LibreOffice cannot export in `gen.py post`: a custom show run by Set Up Show (with a pen colour), master and layout guides (`p15:sldGuideLst`), a gradient and a pattern slide background. Deck 35 (`provisional-35-animations2.pptx`, P9-S4) adds in `gen.py post_anim`: PowerPoint 2010+ transitions in `mc:AlternateContent` (`p14:prism` Cube, `p14:vortex`, `p15:prstTrans` Curtains), Float In by paragraph (`p:bldP build="p"`), a custom motion path (`p:animMotion`) with a Pulse after it, a Spin triggered by a click on the ellipse (interactive sequence), and a 3 s WebM clip (VP8 + Vorbis, ffmpeg) with `p14:trim`, `p14:fade`, a `p14:bmk` that triggers the text box's exit (`onMediaBookmark` + `p14:bmkName`) and a Pause in the click sequence. `pptx/manifest.json` lists per file the topic and a feature list; vocabulary and workflow in `docs/pptx-suite.md`. Regenerate with `scripts/gen-pptx-suite.sh` (sources in `scripts/testdata-src/pptx/`), check with `--verify`.

### Formula reference suite (`formulas/`) - PROVISIONAL

Expected values were computed by LibreOffice 25.2 headless and **must be replaced by Excel-computed values** (workflow in `docs/formula-suite.md`). Regenerate with `scripts/gen-formula-suite.sh` (source in `scripts/testdata-src/formulas.*`), check with `--verify`; formulas are evaluated on sheet `Data`.

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `formulas/fixture.tsv` | Fixture grid (sheets `Data`, `Other`): `sheet, cell, type, value` |
| `formulas/{math,logical,info,text,lookup,datetime,operators,references,errors}.tsv` | 862 cases `formula, type, expected, note` - PROVISIONAL (LibreOffice values; rows with `DIFF:` notes are known to differ from Excel) |
| `formulas/formula-suite.xlsx` | Same cases as a workbook (formulas in `Data!L`, text in `Data!K`); open in Excel, recalc, send back for `--from-xlsx` |

The function list the suite covers is `docs/functions.md`. `*/out/` holds harness output and is git-ignored.
